Answer: B
Reason: The chest radiograph demonstrates multiple small, discrete nodular opacities scattered throughout both lung fields (random distribution), with several appearing dense and calcified. This pattern of diffuse, randomly distributed calcified micronodules is the classic residual finding of healed varicella zoster virus pneumonia, distinguishing it from the typically upper-lobe predominant or lymph-node-associated calcifications of tuberculosis and histoplasmosis.
